newsitem.title: USA: General Environmental Corp says to buy L&T.
newsitem.headline: General Environmental Corp says to buy L&T.

text.p: General Environmental Corp said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to buy L & T Technologies Inc.
A General Environmental spokesman declined to disclose the purchase price.
L & T Technologies are designers and engineers of custom metal recovery and wastewater clean up systems.
General Environmental said L & T Technologies sales are expected to be between $2 million and $2.5 million in 1997.
The acquisition should be complete by mid-summer.
